messages:
Jordan Li: Heads-up: Acme Labs POC started fine then after ~5m they started getting 401s on /v1/generate. Key: acme_demo_rot_key.
Priya Rao: Can you paste a failing curl + response?
Jordan Li: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer acme_demo_rot_key' -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","prompt":"hi"}'
Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized {"error":"Unauthorized","message":"token expired"}
Jordan Li: It worked for a few minutes then started 401s. No deliberate rotation on their side.
Omar Khan: Could be server-side demo key rotation TTL. Please introspect key: GET /v1/admin/keys/acme_demo_rot_key and paste sanitized output.
Jordan Li: Introspect (sanitized): { "key":"acme_demo_rot_key", "org_id":"org-301", "scopes":["api:generate"], "rotated":true, "last_rotated":"2276501050" }
Lena (Sales Eng): That confirms rotation happened. Old key invalidated. For hosted POCs we sometimes seed short-lived demo keys that auto-rotate.
Priya Rao: Quick unblocks: 1) Issue a new key in their org (acme_demo_rot_key_v2). 2) Use an account-scoped key for the trial. 3) If you need zero friction, request a temporary grace window from SRE.
Support Bot: policy-bot: demo-key auto-rotation enforced since 2025-11-02; grace periods are off by default.
Omar Khan: Creating new key now under org-301 with api:generate.
Jordan Li: New key created -> initial success, then after ~30s they hit 429 TooManyRequests (they spawn 50 parallel workers).
Lena (Sales Eng): That's per-key QPS/concurrency. For short POC we can request a temporary uplift; long-term recommend Dedicated or reserved throughput.
Priya Rao: I submitted the POC uplift form (account acme-labs-301) with desired QPS=200, request id r-11aa22.
Support Bot: infra-bot: SRE ticket SRE-8012 created; temporary uplift applied at 2276501128 (QPS +40%).
Jordan Li: Reran tests after uplift -> POC passed end-to-end. Customer asks for rotation/runbook and whether rotation can be zero-downtime.
Lena (Sales Eng): We'll share the runbook. Zero-downtime rotation is possible with key aliasing and dual-key rollout; hosted runbook attached to deal folder.
Jordan Li: Thanks all, closing this swarm. Will re-open if they hit anything else. :white_check_mark:
